chars.C: COUSIN: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers, a thin gold bracelet
chars.B: BOY: a teenage boy wearing a red football jersey with white sleeves and black track pants with white side stripes
chars.A: AUNT: a middle-aged woman wearing a long green house djellaba and a white headscarf, a striped apron
chars.D: DRIVER: a man in his late twenties wearing a black leather jacket and dark sunglasses

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a dark hallway through a half-open bedroom door: the COUSIN sits cross-legged on her bed in a small Moroccan bedroom with a pink blanket, holding a phone to her ear and laughing secretly, one hand over her mouth, eyes glancing toward the door. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in her bedroom: the COUSIN whispers into her phone with a shy excited smile, cupping the phone with her hand so nobody hears, leaning toward the wall, curtains closed, evening.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow Moroccan house hallway with zellige tiles on the lower wall, the BOY stands frozen next to a half-open door, eyes wide in shock, one mitten hand on his chest, overhearing something. Medium shot.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan home: in the foreground the BOY leans on the kitchen doorframe, jealous and suspicious, staring down the hallway toward a closed bedroom door; behind him in the kitchen the AUNT stirs a tagine on a gas stove, not noticing anything.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan home hallway: the COUSIN steps out of her bedroom hiding her phone behind her back, looking at the BOY suspiciously; the BOY sits on a low sedari sofa pretending to watch TV but watching her from the corner of his eye. Both fully visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the front door of a Moroccan house in daylight: the COUSIN, freshly dressed up with a small handbag over her shoulder, beams with joy, eyes sparkling, waving goodbye as she steps out. Medium shot, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A quiet residential street in a small Moroccan town (Kenitra region) with white and ochre houses: in the foreground the BOY hides behind a wall corner, peeking out; further down the street a silver car stops next to the COUSIN, the DRIVER visible through the open car window leaning toward her, she smiles and reaches for the car door. Afternoon light.
